description.en: Yohoia-inspired static teaching arthropod with a subrectangular head shield, paired elbowed anterior appendages and four long terminal fingers, segmented trunk and paddle telson. Fine anatomy and counts simplified; no flagellate whip fingers or lanceolate tail.
description.zh: Yohoia启发静态教学节肢动物，具方形头甲、成对肘状前附肢及四根末端长指、分节体和桨状尾。细节与数量简化；无鞭丝指或矛头尾。

artistic_choices.en: Nominal dimensions, original palette, exact repeated-feature counts and static pose are artistic. No strict species, specimen-copy, locomotion, animation or coexistence reconstruction.

structural_scope.en: Subrectangular shield, paired two-segment elbows with terminal long finger groups and paddle telson. Fine segmentation/soft tissues simplified; distinct from flagellate Leanchoilia.
structural_scope.zh: 方形头甲、成对两长节肘附肢及末端长指组、桨状尾；细节分节和软组织简化，区别于鞭丝指Leanchoilia。
